name: @falling-ts/dsh-force-compact
description: DSH Cordis plugin: hooks the core model-request seam (agent/pre-step + agent/request) to force-compact a session's context and disable thinking per the "强制压缩配置" settings namespace (disableThinking, autoThresholdTokens). Also compacts at each session/flush durability checkpoint. Host-only, pure listener.
